# Generated files that do not make a build "dirty" (#367). Tauri's build scripts rewrite them
# during a build, so a CI job that builds before it packages may see them modified or created,
# and a local macOS build adds the macOS-only updater plugin's entries to the macOS schema.
# One repository-relative path per line; lines starting with # are comments. Read by
# scripts/engine-host-identity.sh (Core ML host), src-tauri/engine-host/ort/build_identity.rs
# (ONNX host), src-tauri/build_identity.rs (app and CLI) and scripts/ci-build-identity.mjs
# (Windows packaging gate).
src-tauri/gen/schemas/acl-manifests.json
src-tauri/gen/schemas/capabilities.json
src-tauri/gen/schemas/desktop-schema.json
src-tauri/gen/schemas/macOS-schema.json
src-tauri/gen/schemas/windows-schema.json
